name: @konxyz/wallet
description: KON v2 central wallet origin (default deploy: id.kon.xyz). Vite + Preact SPA hosted via DNSLink + DNS-ENS contenthash on kon.xyz. Handles passkey + Safe smart account on behalf of apps via postMessage. Self-hostable: deploy the same bundle to id.<your-domain> and override manifest.deployment.wallet_origin.
